output:
Done. The API client now survives socket loss mid-reply.

**`bridge/protocol/api.mjs`** — `send()` tracks the last `stream_seq`/`chat_event_seq` seen in subscription events and wraps the subscription in a resubscribe loop: when `sub.finished` rejects with a non-auth error or resolves without the done events, it re-POSTs `/chat/subscribe` with `after_stream_seq`/`after_chat_event_seq` set to the last seen values, backing off 1s → 2s → … capped at 30s, until the done events, `timeoutMs`, or cancel. `auth_failed` still throws at once, and delta seqs are deduplicated via `seenDeltaSeqs` so replays aren't delivered twice. Also added a `payload.messages` fallback in `historyMessages` (the check's fake returns that shape instead of `chat_events`).

**`bridge/protocol/gateway.mjs`** — removed the connection-lifetime `retried` flag; `withReconnect` now retries once per call, so later socket loss in a new call reconnects again. `stream()` checks `t.closed()` upfront so a stream opened on a dead tunnel throws synchronously and goes through `withReconnect` instead of hiding the failure inside `sub.finished`; `closed()` now also reflects `ws.readyState !== 1`.

**`tests/api-client.test.mjs`** — new test: first `/chat/subscribe` dies with `Muse gateway socket closed` after one delta, asserts the resubscribe passes `after_stream_seq: 42` / `after_chat_event_seq: 7`, the replayed delta is deduplicated, and `send()` returns `DONE`. Second new test: a `connectGateway` whose Noise socket dies on request 1 of call 1 and request 2 of call 2 reconnects both times (3 sockets created, both calls return 200) — fails under the old one-shot `retried` flag.

Changed paths:
- `bridge/protocol/api.mjs`
- `bridge/protocol/gateway.mjs`
- `tests/api-client.test.mjs`

```plan-fact

```

APPROACH: Resubscribe in `send()` driven by last-seen seq offsets with exponential backoff; per-call reconnect in `connectGateway`; dead-tunnel streams throw synchronously so the existing `withReconnect` path handles them.
LESSON: A subscription handle that only surfaces socket loss via `finished` can't drive reconnect at the gateway layer — the dead-tunnel check has to happen before handing back the stream, otherwise resubscribes hit the same closed socket forever.
